method: Comment-aware lexical matching in tracked top-level src/*.c; no preprocessor, compiler or target execution
limitations: Conditional compilation is not evaluated; declarations do not establish runtime support.
Macro-generated declarations, included headers, nested source directories and nonliteral label expressions are outside this catalog.
File-level label declarations are not automatically associated with individual format structures.
No test hashes, passwords, candidate lists, format algorithms or performance measurements are extracted.
